primary_services.value: terminal sterilization; irradiation; microbiological testing; analytical chemistry testing; life sciences and regulatory consulting

quotes.quote: Sterigenics ® is a leading global provider of outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and commercial markets. With our industry recognized expertise, we help to ensure the safety of millions of patients around the world every year. Across our multiple global facilities, we offer our customers a complete range of sterilization services, primarily using the three major technologies: gamma irradiation, ethylene oxide processing and electron beam irradiation as well as nitrogen dioxide sterilization and x-ray irradiation. We are committed to addressing the growing need for sterilization across the world and partnering with our customers to eliminate threats to human health.

Nelson Labs ® is a global leader in outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. We serve multiple customers across multiple facilities in the United States, Europe, Asia and Mexico. With a comprehensive array of over 900 laboratory tests and the expertise of Regulatory Compliance Associates ®, a recognized leader in life science consulting, we support our customers from initial product development and sterilization validation, through regulatory approval and ongoing product testing for sterility, safety and quality assurance. We are regarded as a best-in-class partner with a strong track record of collaborating with customers to solve complex issues.
